messages:
sophie: Hey team — quick prep thread for next Tues webinar with a panel + breakout rooms. Need a short run-through for: reg page fields, Zoom settings, recording + backup, and post-event follow-ups. Can owners callouts? :wave:
dave: I can own Zoom ops. Quick checklist:
- create meeting with practice session on
- enable cloud recording + auto-delete 90d
- enable live transcript + CC
- set co-hosts: diego, me
- enable breakout rooms and pre-assign CSV
- disable participant screen share by default
- alternative hosts: lizzy, sam
Also will kick off a test recording Wed 10am. :white_check_mark:
lizzy: I'll do the reg page + HubSpot mapping. Reg page notes:
- fields: first,last,email,company,role,company_size (dropdown), use_case (free text)
- hidden fields: utm_campaign, utm_source, org_id
- checkbox: agree to marketing emails (do NOT pre-check)
- confirmation email: include replay link + "request a demo" CTA button
HubSpot mapping rules:
- lifecycle_stage -> MQL if company_size > 50 OR role in [product, eng, platform]
- source -> utm_source
I'll draft confirmation copy now and share for approval.
sam: Post-event plan:
- attendees: send 1h after — recording + one-pager + CTA to book demo
- registrants no-show: 2h after — highlights + recording + 1-question survey
- heavy-engagers (watched >60%) -> SDR queue w/ note + transcript link
- scoring: tag webinar-2026-april ; attendees +10, registrants no-show +2
I'll add sequences in Outreach + HubSpot and wire the engagement webhook.
webops-bot: zoom-scheduler created meeting 1802109100 "Scaling Inference: tradeoffs" scheduled 2026-04-12 17:00 UTC — cloud_recording=on, live_transcript=on, passcode=required.
sophie: Nice. Can we also capture a high-res slide deck upload location? Want to include in follow-up. Owner: lizzy for assets, dave for recording. Also need captions (VTT) export from cloud recording after the event. Any objections to 90d retention window? Compliance ok for marketing?
dave: 90d retention is fine for marketing assets; for enterprise customers we'll store elsewhere. I'll export VTT after the test and stash a copy in the shared drive.
lizzy: Drafting confirmation email copy now. Subject options (pick one):
- "Thanks for joining: replay + resources — Redwood Inference"
- "Replay: Scaling inference across clouds — Redwood Inference"
I'll push copy to the doc and ping for sign-off tomorrow. :memo:
sophie: Action items summary:
- dave: Zoom test Wed 10am, enable preassign CSV, export VTT after event
- lizzy: reg page + HubSpot mappings + confirmation email copy + upload slide deck link
- sam: build post-event sequences, SDR tagging, engagement webhook, reporting by UTM
- webops-bot: meeting created (see above)
I'll follow up with calendar invites and a rehearsal slot. :rocket:
